name: CaseFlexDirectionReverseByAxis
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "flex-direction-reverse-by-axis" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: flex-direction: row-reverse at the DEFAULT axis value and row at the other (the carbon.accordion `align` shape, whose default IS the reversed one)
